_readme: HOW TO ADD A STORY: copy one object in 'stories', paste it at the top of the list, and edit name, area, quote, date (YYYY-MM-DD). 'photo' is optional (path in assets/img/stories/ or ""). Only publish names/photos with the driver's permission. If the list is empty the page shows 'Stories coming soon'. Full guide: STORIES-README.md
